notes:
A compound of ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧ (public finance) + ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (policy). Refers to government decisions about spending, taxation, and borrowing to influence the economy. A fundamental term in economics and political news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to implement fiscal policy
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧な{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}: expansionary fiscal policy
- ⟦{緊縮|きんしゅく}→緊縮：13891_kinshuku⟧{財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}: austerity fiscal policy
- {財政政策|ざいせいせいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧: shift in fiscal policy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金融政策|きんゆうせいさく}→金融政策：18097_kinyuuseisaku⟧: monetary policy (central bank's control of money supply and interest rates — the other major economic policy tool)
